title: fynkel.ThirdPersonCamera
description: A camera rig that orbits a target (blueprint §19.2d item 9: `Follow` specialised for the third person). Every tick, after physics, the entity is placed `distance` metres from the target's world position + `pivot` at `yaw`/`pitch` (radians; yaw 0 is behind the target on +Z, pitch positive above it looking down) and turned to look at the pivot; with a `look_action` named, that 2D action turns the rig at `sensitivity` radians per second per unit of input (x turns the view right, y up) between `min_pitch` and `max_pitch`; `yaw`/`pitch` are written back so gameplay reads (and may set) them. With `collision_radius > 0` a sphere of that radius is cast from the pivot towards the rig against `mask` (the target's own colliders excluded) and the rig pulls in to the hit, never closer than `min_distance`. The target is named (`fynkel.Name`, the first match in entity order); an empty or unknown name leaves the entity where it is.

target.description: The followed entity's name; empty follows nothing.

pivot.description: Offset from the target's world position the rig looks at and orbits, metres.

min_distance.description: Closest the pull-in brings the rig, metres, `0..=distance`.

look_action.description: A 2D action that turns the rig; empty leaves yaw/pitch to gameplay.

sensitivity.description: Radians per second per unit of `look_action` input.

collision_radius.description: Radius of the pull-in sphere cast, metres (`0` disables).
